g.title: rule_acceptances
g.text: v36 (T-000241) — the owner's decisions on contributor proposals: one immutable row per receipt `.sdh/rule-decisions/<rule>.<login>.<rev>.json`. Two independent tracks: `status` is the local work pipeline (prepared -> decided -> applied -> rendered, plus stable side states conflicted / expired / superseded) and `pub_state` is the receipt's own journey to origin (pending / blocked / published / overtaken), which never rolls `status` back. `proposal_text` is the validated snapshot the canon is applied FROM — the mutable proposal file is never re-read for it.
GitHub login on the proposal file name.
Full blob sha of the open proposal version decided on — the CAS token of the decision; part of the PK and of the receipt file name.
The exact canonical JSON published to `.sdh/rule-decisions/`; written once at `prepared` and never regenerated, so a receipt is immutable.
Validated snapshot of the decided proposal version's text.
prepared | decided | applied | rendered | conflicted | expired | superseded — the local pipeline; `conflicted` waits for the explicit UI resolution (apply / dismiss).
pending | blocked | published | overtaken — the receipt's publication life; `published` is set only from the origin-tracking ref, never from the local push.
sha256 of the rule's canon text at `prepared` — the divergence check an apply runs against (`conflicted` when the canon moved meanwhile).
sha256 of the canon text actually applied; NULL until applied.

g.title: repositories
g.text: A repository belonging to at most one project. May be GitHub-backed or local-only.
ON DELETE SET NULL — the only non-cascading FK in the schema. Deleting a project orphans its repositories rather than destroying them.
UNIQUE, and nullable since v13 so local-only repos (never pushed to GitHub) can exist. The last path segment is the canonical folder name used for all cross-repo doc folders.
'microservice' is still legal here but is legacy: v12 NULLed every such row when microservice became a project type rather than a repo role.
Stable GitHub identifier — the basis of rename detection.
Lazy-migration marker (v18); NULL means the repo's MD has never been imported.
Lazy-migration marker (v21). While NULL, the first task sync suppresses 'created' events so backfilling legacy files doesn't flood the timeline.
v25 — JSON map of repo-wide (not per-environment) deploy placeholder values.
v28 — NULL means auto-commit is off for this repo.
v34 — the owner's switch (main side) that puts this repo into contributor mode. 0 = not shared.
v34 — cached role of THIS install for the repo: 'main' (owner, publishes the structure), 'contributor', or 'pending' (a contributor who has requested access). NULL means the repo is not shared.
v34 — status code of the shared-mode sync (e.g. 'needs_manual_merge'); NULL means no pending condition.
v34 — JSON map of the last imported blob sha per shared file, so an unchanged file is not imported again.

v35 (T-000243) — per-repo opt-out for sharing docs/superpowers/ in contributor mode. 1 (default) = the folder travels with the shared set; 0 = specs stay local-only. Independent of shared_mode: settable before sharing is enabled, so it lives on the row, not in shared_import JSON.

g.title: rule_acceptances:repo_id->repositories:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (repo_id) REFERENCES repositories (id) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE MATCH NONE
